name: obsidian-organize-marketplace
description: Personal-knowledge-management plugins for Obsidian vaults. Ships the obsidian-organize plugin with five skills: bootstrap (vault layout matching hermes-wiki-super's Clippings-processed / wiki / wiki-map), process_clippings (turn raw Clippings/ files into wiki/<topic>/ entries), research (gather source material), add_wiki (promote to topic note, with --hierarchical / --major flags for multi-section research that becomes a per-section leaf-note tree), remove_wiki (retire topic + archive).

plugins.name: obsidian-organize
plugins.description: Topic-organizer for Obsidian vaults. Exposes five skills on the namespace:skill convention: obsidian-organize:bootstrap (set up Clippings-processed / wiki / wiki-map layout), obsidian-organize:research (gather source material), obsidian-organize:process_clippings (distill raw Clippings/ into leaf notes), obsidian-organize:add_wiki (promote to topic note, including --hierarchical / --major modes for multi-section research), obsidian-organize:remove_wiki (retire topic + archive). Inherits frontmatter + tag conventions from hermes-wiki-super's add-wiki and process-clippings.
